newsitem.title: CHINA: Group holds up banner to Deng in Tiananmen Square.
newsitem.headline: Group holds up banner to Deng in Tiananmen Square.

text.p: A group of people raised a banner in Beijing's Tiananmen Square to mourn China's deceased paramount leader Deng Xiaoping whose memorial was held in the nearby Great Hall of the People on Tuesday.
"Our work unit told us to stay at home and watch television," said a teacher in the group. "I feel that is not enough to commemorate Deng Xiaoping so we came here today."
"Carry out and fulfil the wishes of Xiaoping, strengthen the national power of China," the banner said.

Dozens of bystanders gathered around the small group, who stood at the base of the Monument to the Revolutionary Martyrs in the centre of the square after police removed a cordon thrown around the vast space during the memorial rites.
One of the group held a picture of Deng, who died last Wednesday aged 92, after ruling China for 18 years.
